description: Multi-chain wallet portfolio with USD values. One call: ETH, WETH, USDC and USDT balances for an address across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism, each with a USD value, plus the total USD value and per-chain subtotals. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"address":"0xd8dA…6045","totalUsd":15234.12,"chains":{"base":{"usd":120.5,"assets":[{"symbol":"ETH","amount":"0.05","usd":116.3}]}},"ethPriceUsd":2326}. Price: $0.0064 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: wallet_portfolio
